_description: Master feature list for the Futuraria Design Harness. The Leader reads this file to know what needs work. Implementers pick ONE task with status 'pending'. Only ONE task in_progress at a time per account.

_rules.one_at_a_time: Only one task can be 'in_progress' at any time. harness_claim_feature enforces this server-side.
_rules.implementer_pick: Implementers pick from pending tasks. They never create tasks — only the Leader creates via studio_create_card.
_rules.status_flow: pending → in_progress → review → done | feedback → in_progress (retry)
_rules.review_required: Every task MUST pass review before marking done. harness_submit_for_review → harness_evaluate_checkpoint.

features.title: Diseño de post 1080×1080
features.brief: Crear un diseño para Instagram 1080×1080 con estilo moderno
